title: BEQDesigner .beq project file
description: Written by File > Save Project and read by File > Load Project. Stored as gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSON; decompress to get the JSON described here. An array of all loaded signals (each a single-channel or bass-managed signal). master_name/slave_names cross-references are resolved by name against other entries in the same array on load. Produced by model.signal.SignalModel.to_json and read back by model.codec.signalmodel_from_json.
